Current Offerings

— L&L ON TAP —

1) Fresh Hop Howdy, Friend
West Coast IPA / 6.5% ABV
[ featuring Citra from Westwood Farms & Simcoe Cryo Fresh® from YCH ]
This year saw the introduction of L&L’s first year-round beer and we are chuffed to be brewing a fresh hop version of this new crowd favorite. All of our Citra beers are brewed with Citra from Westwood Farms (OR) and we are stoked to be brewing with their fresh Citra for Fresh Hop Howdy, Friend. In addition to the 200 pounds of fresh Citra, we’ve punched things up with Simcoe Cryo Fresh®, Mosaic Dynaboost, El Dorado, and Riwaka.
—
Hops: Fresh Citra, Simcoe Cryo Fresh®, Mosaic Dynaboost, El Dorado & Riwaka
Malts: Pilsner & Extra Pale White Wheat

2) Trampled by Koalas
Extra Pale Ale / 5.1% ABV
Unlike a surprise drop bear attack, this extra pale ale is a light and bright experience. With a striking golden hue and a punchy dose of some of our favorite southern hemisphere hops, expect notes of lime, pineapple, and guava delicately intertwined with a crisp malt body.
—
Hops: Nelson Sauvin & Citra
Malts: Superior Pilsen, Low Color Wheat & Chit Malt

3) Fractal Sunset
Double IPA / 8.9% ABV
2023 SIP Best of the NW Platinum Winner
2023 Alpha King Finalist
Fractal Sunset shows us exactly why Citra and Mosaic have become the banger hops we’ve all grown to love. This big double IPA was hit hard with Citra, Cryo Mosaic, Cryo Simcoe, and newcomer Nectaron—leaving an aftermath of overripe mango, pineapple, and tropical fruit flavors in its wake.
—
Hops: Nectaron, Citra, Cryo Mosaic & Cryo Simcoe
Malts: Pilsner & Extra Pale White Wheat

4) Parliament of Owls
West Coast IPA / 6.7% ABV
Thanks to the latest in concentrated hop products and state-of-the-art extraction techniques, Parliament of Owls completely bypasses the fledging stage and takes flight straight into the stratosphere. This modern West Coast IPA may be saturated with loads of hop goodness, but it still manages to remain dry and supremely crushable. Loads of freshly crushed citrus, tropical pineapple, and a touch of sticky weed will leave you hooting for more.
—
Hops: Centennial, Citra, Cryo Citra, Cryo Simcoe, Mosaic & Cryo Columbus
Malts: Pilsner & Vienna

5) The Night Is Dark and Full of Terrors
Cascadian Dark Ale / 7% ABV
2024 WA Beer Awards Gold Medalist
We’re bringing Cascadian Dark Ale back from the dead with our modernized take on the much loved and maligned style. Expect boughs of piney hop goodness balanced with bright citrus zest and a touch of tropical punch. This beer may be as dark as our brewer’s soul, but it only dips a toe into the roasty abyss with just a kiss of light chocolate and coffee.
—
Hops: Crosby Estate Amarillo, Simcoe, Centennial, Mosaic, Chinook & Cryo Citra
Malts: Pilsner, Alix Craft 2-Row, Caramunich III & Carahell

6) Cloud Sipper
Hazy IPA / 7% ABV
Available exclusively at L&L and Tapped Public House locations
This soft, billowing IPA boasts heavenly amounts of ripe tropical fruit and citrus thanks to the abundance of hand-selected lots of Yakima’s finest hops. Expect vibrant fruit, a fluffy mouthfeel, and an ethereal drying bitterness on the finish.
—
Hops: Crosby Estate Comet, Nelson Sauvin, Cryo Krush, Dolcita, Tangier & Cryo Citra
Malts: Pilsner, Flaked Oats, Extra Pale White Wheat & Malted Oats

7) Fresh Hop Cloud Sipper
Hazy IPA / 6.8% ABV
[featuring Mosaic from Sauve and Son Farms & Simcoe Cryo Fresh® from YCH]
Fresh Hop Cloud Sipper, brewed exclusively for the Tapped Public House locations, features 200 pounds of fresh Mosaic from Sauve & Son Farms, our favorite Mosaic grower in Sunnyside (WA). To punch things up, this hazy has been hit with Cryo Mosaic, Riwaka, and Simcoe Cryo Fresh® on the cold side.
—
Hops: Fresh Mosaic, Cryo Mosaic, Riwaka, and Simcoe Cryo Fresh®
Malts: Pilsner, Flaked Oats & Malted Oats

8) Raspberry Revelry
Fruited Sour / 5.7% ABV
This refreshing bevvy balances a crisp, clean acidity with festive notes of fresh raspberry and an enchanting hint of lime. brewed for optimal enjoyability, Raspberry Revelry is a top-notch example of what a balanced sour beer can be.
—
Hops: Hallertau Mittelfrüh
Malts: Pilsner & Extra Pale Premium Pilsner

9) Nick & Teddy’s Excellent Adventure
Hefeweizen / 5% ABV
For this year’s GRAINMAKER Fest we partnered up with our homies at The Grain Shed to create a classic Bavarian-style Hefeweizen—brewed with 100% NW-grown malted wheat and barley and 100% Oregon-grown hops. Expect well-balanced notes of bready wheat complemented by delectable aromatics of banana and spice dancing upon a soft and pillowy mouthfeel.
—
Hops: Sterling
Malts: Steffi Pils & Russian Red Wheat

10) New Beer Coming Soon!

11) Obstinate Intentions
Hoppy Belgian Ale / 4.9% ABV
One of the highlights of our brewer’s recent trip to Belgium was a visit to Brasserie de la Senne. Blown away by the beers, Nick came home energized by the experience and immediately started planning an homage to Taras Boulba, de la Senne’s bracingly dry and hop-forward flagship.

Our homage, Obstinate Intentions, features a robust hopping of classic Continental varieties. The resulting assertive bitterness and herbaceous, floral hop bouquet is lovingly layered upon a complex Belgian yeast profile.
—
Hops: Saphir & Czech Saaz
Malts: Extra Pale Premium Pilsner, Pale Wheat, Pilsner & Extra Pale White Wheat

12) The Pale Project
American Pale Ale / 5.4% ABV
2022 WA Beer Awards Bronze Medalist
The Pale Project is a collaboration between three homebrew-loving friends—Shawn Miller, Tony Ochsner, and L&L brewer, Nick Ladd—who cut their craft teeth on early 2000’s pale ales, but also appreciate today’s more hop-forward pale ales. This is an ongoing project that seeks to find the happy balance between traditional and contemporary takes on pale ale. This iteration is lightly malty with a punchy dry hop of Cryo Citra, Mosaic, and Simcoe.

This beer is brewed in honor of Shawn, L&L’s biggest supporter and loudest advocate. He was an amazing human who always led by example and is fiercely missed by all who knew him. We hope this project conveys his passion for the craft of beer making and captures his spectacular spirit. A portion of proceeds from sales of this beer will be donated to the Cascadia College Foundation to help fund the Shawn Miller Memorial Scholarship for First Generation Students.
—
Hops: Crosby Estate Comet, Cryo Citra, Mosaic & Simcoe
Malts: Pale Ale & Alix Craft 2-Row

13) Your Shout, Bruv
Pub Ale / 4.2% ABV
Your Shout, Bruv is our take on the classic pub ale—brewed with a base of Washington-grown malt. Notes of toasted cracker, light toffee, clean bitterness, and ultimate quaffability make this the perfect tipple for long sessions with your mates or binging the latest series of Doctor Who.
—
Hops: Sterling
Malts: Baronesse Pale, Baronesse Vienna & Russian Red Wheat

— Bottle pours —

The Westchester series is L&L’s take on mixed-fermentation farmhouse-style saison—celebrating our unique house culture of wild yeast and bacteria as seen through the lens of co-ferments with some of the finest fruit Washington has to offer.

Westchester: Arctic White Nectarine
Mixed-fermentation Saison / 5% ABV
For this iteration of Westchester, Arctic White nectarines from Collins Family Orchards in Selah, WA were fermented for over a year on their native wild cultures before being macerated with our house mixed-fermentation saison and bottle conditioned. Expect a nectarine-forward delight with delicate floral notes.

Westchester: Pluot
Mixed-fermentation Saison / 5% ABV
For this iteration of Westchester, pluots from Collins Family Orchards in Selah, WA were fermented for over a year on their native wild cultures before being macerated with our house mixed-fermentation saison and bottle conditioned. Expect nuanced notes of soft and juicy pluot.
